question: What ritual actions must be performed upon the prepared bed?
premises: A prior preparatory action has been completed.
The protective thread tying is to be performed.
The deity or object should be laid upon the bed.
inference: After completing the prior preparation, one must perform the protective thread tying and lay the object upon the bed.
uncertainties: The exact referent to be laid upon the bed is not specified in this verse alone.
plain_english: Having done so, one should perform the tying of the protective thread and lay it upon the bed.
